about: NEW-DOTS-2 (owner, 10 Nov 2026): the things on a page a release note can point at, so a red dot leads the person to the exact place. Each id is the element's data-new-anchor. route: the page it is on (the note's href); href: where to open it (a tab of the page), when that differs; label: its name in plain words; via: the things to open on the way (a menu, a tab), outermost first. A release note's line names one with {"text", "href", "anchor"}. The release-notes writer reads this file (/opt/release-comms/relcomms.py), and a web unit test keeps it equal to the data-new-anchor ids in the code (lib/new-anchors.test.mjs). Ids: lowercase words joined by dots or dashes.
